title: Surreal Pink Tower
description: A surreal scene depicts a man in a black suit standing with his back to the viewer, holding two glowing orbs containing figures and faces. He stands within a large circular portal set into a melting pink tower covered in dripping paint and numerous white and black dogs in various poses. A giant anthropomorphic moon with a human face and swirling patterns dominates the pink and purple sky, also dripping orange liquid.
prompt: surreal painting of a man in a black suit viewed from behind, standing inside a glowing blue circular portal set in a tall pink tower that is melting with orange drips, the tower is covered with dozens of white and black dogs in various poses, the man holds two smaller glowing orbs one showing a lone figure and another with faces and aliens, a giant anthropomorphic moon with a detailed human face and craters floats in a swirling pink and purple sky also dripping orange liquid, dreamlike atmosphere
